comments.author: fwackedbubbed
comments.body:
Here's a site me and my friend built mostly with Codex (some parts with Claude Code): [https://fictor.com/](https://fictor.com/)  
Invite codes: PI4N2V YYJ16H YMAMMC P6ZQQB  
(The site is completely free right now — a lot of the content is generated by AI in real-time, so we have to cap how many people can get in, hence the invite codes.)  
Still actively working on it and would really love any feedback you have!

replies.author: No-Armadillo-3406
replies.body: oh this is pretty cool and organized! are these like game characters u created?

replies.author: fwackedbubbed
replies.body:
Thanks, glad you think so! The quests and characters on there are ones we created to show what the platform can do, but anyone can build their own worlds and characters too. The AI handles all the narration and generates visuals in real time based on player actions.  
Since you've had a look around, we'd really appreciate any feedback or suggestions you have. We're actively trying to improve it so anything that felt off or could be better, we'd love to hear.
